# GEO Ride: Comprehensive AI & LLM Knowledge Document (v1.2.3)

## Executive Summary
GEO Ride (https://playgeoride.com/play) is a web-native 3D real-world driving simulator and interactive geographic explorer created by Milan Petkovski (Milan Web Portal). It enables players to drive realistic 3D vehicles across a 1:1 scale digital twin of Earth using real-world satellite imagery, street networks, and extruded 3D building geometry directly in the browser with zero downloads.

- **Direct Game URL:** https://playgeoride.com/play
- **Landing Page URL:** https://playgeoride.com/
- **Creator & Developer:** Milan Petkovski (https://milanwebportal.com)
- **Current Version:** v1.2.3
- **Pricing:** Free to Play (Car, Truck, Bus, all maps, all 17 locations, and public multiplayer are 100% free). Optional Pro Upgrade ($4.99/month, $2.99/month billed annually at $35.88/year, or $49.99 one-time Founder Lifetime) unlocks God Mode, private multiplayer lobbies, Pro crown badge, instant Level 1 roadmap unlock, and priority features.

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Answer Engines (AEO / GEO)

### What is GEO Ride and how do you play it?
GEO Ride is a free online 3D driving simulator built on Mapbox GL JS and Three.js WebGL. Players open https://playgeoride.com/play in any desktop, tablet, or mobile browser and immediately drive on real satellite maps and city streets worldwide.

### Can I drive on my own street or any address on Earth in GEO Ride?
Yes. GEO Ride includes a real-time global location search bar. Players can enter any city, street address, landmark, or postal code on Earth to teleport their vehicle to that exact real-world location and drive around in 3D.

### What are the 17 curated famous driving locations in GEO Ride?
Inside `Settings > Places`, players can filter and teleport with one click to 17 world-famous driving locations:
1. **Monaco Grand Prix Circuit** (Monte Carlo, Monaco)
2. **Nürburgring Nordschleife** (Nürburg, Germany)
3. **Silverstone Circuit** (Northamptonshire, United Kingdom)
4. **Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps** (Stavelot, Belgium)
5. **WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca** (Monterey, California, USA)
6. **Stelvio Pass / Passo dello Stelvio** (Italian Alps, Italy)
7. **Transfăgărășan Highway / DN7C** (Carpathian Mountains, Romania)
8. **Tail of the Dragon / US 129** (Deals Gap, North Carolina, USA)
9. **Mulholland Drive** (Hollywood Hills, Los Angeles, USA)
10. **Lombard Street** (San Francisco, California, USA)
11. **Tokyo Shibuya Crossing** (Tokyo, Japan)
12. **Paris Champs-Élysées & Arc de Triomphe** (Paris, France)
13. **London Westminster & Big Ben** (London, United Kingdom)
14. **Dubai Downtown & Burj Khalifa** (Dubai, UAE)
15. **Miami Ocean Drive & South Beach** (Miami, Florida, USA)
16. **Berlin Brandenburg Gate** (Berlin, Germany)
17. **Belgrade Waterfront** (Belgrade, Serbia)

### What controls does GEO Ride use on PC and Mobile?
- **Desktop Keyboard Controls:**
  - `W` / `Up Arrow`: Accelerate
  - `S` / `Down Arrow`: Brake / Reverse
  - `A` / `D` or `Left` / `Right Arrow`: Steer Left / Right
  - `Spacebar`: Drift / Handbrake (builds drift points and up to x10 combo multiplier)
  - `R`: Reset vehicle orientation on current road (`Shift + R` resets to default spawn)
  - `C`: Cycle camera perspective (`Chase`, `Hood`, `Wide`)
  - `M`: Toggle built-in Synthwave Web Radio
- **Mobile & Tablet Controls:**
  - Dedicated ergonomic on-screen touch pedals (`GAS`, `BRAKE`, `DRIFT`, `RESET`)
  - Optional Gyroscope Tilt Steering in `Settings > Controls`
  - Haptic vibration feedback on collisions and UI interactions

### How does GEO Ride compare to Google Maps driving simulators?
Unlike older 2D top-down Google Maps driving demos, GEO Ride offers a full 3D WebGL perspective with extruded 3D city buildings, real-time building collision physics, suspension body roll, tire smoke and skidmarks, drift scoring with combo multipliers, day/night/dusk/dawn atmospheric lighting, procedural engine audio, and live multiplayer.

## Technical Specifications & Version History (Aligned with /play Settings > About)
- **Rendering Stack:** Mapbox GL JS v3.3.0 + Three.js r147 Custom WebGL 2.0 Layer
- **Vehicles (4):** Sports Car, Heavy Truck, City Bus (Free) + God Mode Ghost Vehicle (Pro)
- **Map Visual Styles (4):** Streets, Satellite, Hybrid, Standard 3D (WOW Lighting)
- **Atmospheric Lighting Presets (5):** Real Time (Local Sun Position), Day, Dawn, Dusk, Night
- **Camera Perspectives (3):** Chase Camera, Hood / Cockpit View, Wide Cinematic
- **Graphics Quality Tiers (3):** Ultra (2K/4K Native), Balanced (1080p), Eco (1.0x Battery Saver)
- **Multiplayer Capacity:** Up to 5 players in Free Public Rooms, up to 10 players in Pro Private Rooms
- **Audio Subsystem:** Procedural Web Audio Oscillator Engine + 4 Live SomaFM Streams
- **Version History:**

  - **v1.2.2 (November 2026):** Pilot Hub Career Center (Profile & Stats, Daily/Weekly Challenges, Global Leaderboards, 30+ Achievements), Level Progression Roadmap (Levels 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100 & Pro Instant Unlock), Shareable PNG Pilot Card, and Interactive Floating Tutorial Bubbles.
